Hi Evan — great to meet you over email. Welcome and thanks for lining this up.

Short answers up front:
- We prefer the attached buyer intake spreadsheet (redwood_buyer_intake_form.xlsx). Please fill the highlighted fields (legal entity, tax ID, remit-to address, billing contact).
- Yes, we require a W-9 (US suppliers) and a bank letter or voided check for ACH. If you need to wire instead, include wire instructions (bank name, ABA, SWIFT if international).
- For POs to be accepted by our AP system we need the remit-to exact legal name + address to match the vendor record; please also include any tax-exempt certificates if applicable.

I'm looping in Marcus (payments) and Dev (vendor ops) to confirm timeline and to create the vendor record once we have the intake form and docs. Typical timeline after complete docs: 1–2 business days to create vendor, then we can push the PO. If you want us to prioritize for the 12/9 date, please mark the sheet with "PRIORITY: 12/9".

Next steps for you:
1) Complete and return the attached redwood_buyer_intake_form.xlsx.
2) Attach vendor_W9.pdf and bank_letter.pdf (or voided check).
3) If the MSA isn't signed, please send signed_msa.pdf or confirm status (we can route to legal if needed).

I'll create a procurement ticket and follow up with a confirmation email once the vendor is active.

Best,
Maya Srinivasan
